note: Public pilot water bodies for prototypes, derived by tools/build_pilot_manifest.py from examples/pilot-regions.json. Customer water bodies never enter this repository (assumption A8). Tile membership is not recorded here. The gap survey discovers it from the catalog.

dataset.name: USGS National Hydrography Dataset, Waterbody - Large Scale layer
dataset.provider: U.S. Geological Survey, The National Map
dataset.service_copyright: USGS TNM – National Hydrography Dataset.  Data Refreshed July, 2026.

terms.text: Map services and data downloaded from The National Map are free and in the public domain.

dataset.acknowledgment: Map services and data available from U.S. Geological Survey, National Geospatial Program.

selection.rule: Per region and size class, the candidate whose width is nearest the class width, by absolute log ratio. Ties go to the smaller source id. Width is the square root of the area.
selection.area_method: Shoelace formula on a local equirectangular plane per ring, sphere radius 6371008.8 m, holes subtracted, computed after coordinate rounding.
